fever-set-point.alt: Graph of temperature (36 to 40 °C) against time (0 to 14 hours). A dashed set-point line steps up from about 36.6 to 39 at hour 2, when pyrogens arrive, and back down at hour 10, when they are cleared. A solid core-temperature line lags behind: it climbs to 39 over about an hour and a half after the step up (point A, body below set point), holds on the plateau (point B, lines together), and falls back over about an hour and a half after the step down (point C, body above set point).
